notes.title: Now 100% AI-Free + SFW Mode Added
notes.content:
[p]We’ve done a lot in this update![/p][p]
[/p][h2]1. We are AI free!!![/h2][p]Most importantly, [b]we’ve completely removed all AI-generated music from the game.[/b][/p][p]The new licensed soundtrack features [u]music by artist René Breitbarth[/u].[/p][p][b]This means [/b][b][i]Night Dessert[/i][/b][b] is now made entirely without AI-generated content (yay!). [/b]ːsteamhappyː[/p][p]
[/p][h2]2. Stream friendly SFW option[/h2][p]We also added a [b]Safe For Work[/b] (SFW) checkbox in the main menu, so if you want to stream the game, you can do so without any worries! This mode disables all visual nudity.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]3. Smaller big fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Continue button more fluid: since many of you mentioned being bothered by the unskippable letter-by-letter text, we’ve fixed it. Pressing the spacebar/continue button now instantly reveals the full line[/p][/*][*][p]New Feature: Mobile gallery now supports fullscreen view[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed phone scaling issue[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]--[/p][p]Enjoy![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367096/2b930a283f4414d7f769b06250eb9b9752aaced1.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Night Shift Is Here!
notes.content:
Hey there, night wanderer!

We’ve got some news for you behind the counter.
[b]Episode 2[/b] is now live and part of the free demo!

This new day brings:
[list]
[*] new characters
[*] extra drama
[*] questionable pastries, and...
[*] some rather hands-on moments.
[/list]
This is still a [b]demo[/b]: imperfect and evolving with every shift.
But we wanted to let you in and share the process while it’s still raw.

So thank you for being part of this weird world we're building. Your support makes a difference!

If you haven’t already, wishlist us on Steam, it helps a lot.
And the next episode? It’s already cooking.

Now... let the night shift begin.
